description: This Java source file defines a helper class 'Log' for simplified logging in Android applications. It provides static methods for different log levels, managing a chain of LogNode objects for custom logging behavior. The class acts as a wrapper around Android's native android.util.Log, allowing for more flexible log management and interop.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: Helper class providing static methods for logging. It abstracts LogNode chain management and offers methods corresponding to different log levels.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current head of the LogNode chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode chain where log data will be sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Dispatches a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional throwable to the LogNode chain.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a verbose message, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a debug message, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs an info message, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a warning message or warning with exception.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs an error message, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs an assertion-level message or with an exception.
